name: YiVad
description:
Vue 3.5 admin dashboard — the management UI member of the Yi family.

ProTable-driven, four layout modes, dynamic routing with backend menu API, and button-level permissions via `v-auth`.

**Axis:** componentization.

name: YiAi
description:
FastAPI backend server — the single source of truth for all Yi-family apps.

AI chat (Ollama), file management with dual-write persistence, RAG, RSS aggregation, WeCom messaging, and the agent loop.

**Axis:** modularization.

name: YiPet
description:
Chrome MV3 browser extension — injects an interactive pet companion into any page.

Multi-role chat, knowledge grounding, and a cross-project bridge to YiVad.

**Axis:** componentization + API layering.

name: YiKnowledge
description:
Markdown knowledge base — 7 role directories, 4 pipeline stages.

Serves both humans (documentation) and AI (RAG data source for YiAi's BRD Agent).
